outcome: Accidental fetal skin lacerations (AFL) during cesarean section
cohort: 14,666 cesarean section deliveries, with 48 cases of AFL and 14,618 controls
finding: Premature rupture of membranes (PROM) and meconium-stained amniotic fluid were significantly associated with increased risk of accidental fetal skin lacerations during cesarean section, particularly in urgent cases.
mod_finding: This study found that urgent cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of accidental fetal skin lacerations.
